claims.verbatim:
Steamship Baltic, Jones, Bremen, July 19, via Southamp-
ton 22d, with mdse and passengers, to Ruger Bros. 4th inst,
lat 41 45, lon 64 33, passed brig W H Bigelow (Br); 5th, lat 41
03, lon 68 23, bark Anna E Garden.
